decisions.rationale: Override validation is performed only for direct specs. Business and requirements inputs silently ignore unknown or unmatched override keys because update_bounds writes only matching existing bounds and no corresponding validation occurs.

The materialization name is derived only from the Markdown stem and process ID, and std::fs::write opens that predictable path without exclusive creation. An existing or same-process materialization can therefore be silently truncated, while either LiterateState later removes the shared path unconditionally, allowing repeated materializations or path collisions to overwrite or prematurely delete an active artifact.

Both paths consistently use the internal action name for model lookup or execution and apply display_name only to the emitted action label; parameter names remain raw in both outputs. No cross-contract mismatch is demonstrated.
